comment: One CONSISTENT landing page per product, so every creative's offered product has somewhere to land — a page-less product ends its creative's funnel at CLICK, and in a shared market that ad still wins impressions on CTR while earning zero. shows_concept_ids = the product's catalog attributes plus the concepts its creative claims. 4000108 is the one VIOLATING variant: the Huarache page with DISCOUNT (5011) removed, so the 'Up to 40% Off' creative's expectation is not met on the page — the expectation_violation exhibit. resolve_pages takes the LOWEST page id per product, so 4000101 wins by default and 4000108 only enters through an explicit page_ids A/B row.
